nodes.rationale: Versioned, clinician-reviewed each release; classes imminent, self_harm, suicidal_ideation, harm_to_others, psychosis_distress; English and Roman Urdu spellings.

nodes.label: Crisis screen
nodes.rationale: No AI-generated text, no animation beyond a 150 ms fade, no red or alarm styling.

nodes.label: DistilRoBERTa risk classifier
nodes.rationale: Reads current message plus two previous user messages so multi-turn signals still fire; thresholds live in config and change only with a passing eval run.

nodes.label: Hard Stop (high risk response)
nodes.rationale: High signals abort or skip the LLM call, show a full-screen crisis view with no AI text, write crisis_event, raise a crisis flag, alert the linked psychologist within 60 s and lock the session.

nodes.label: 3-token negation window
nodes.rationale: Lowers suicidal_ideation to distress for negated phrases but never lowers imminent.

nodes.label: Pre-release helpline number verification
nodes.rationale: Numbers change; every number is called before each release and the date and caller recorded in Tracker.

nodes.label: Psychologist alert
nodes.rationale: In-app plus email for FYP (SMS later); pseudonym unless identity scope; no transcript text in email.

nodes.label: Safety pathway (moderate risk response)
nodes.rationale: Moderate signals (PHQ-9 item 9 = 1 or 2, classifier distress > 0.8, C-SSRS Q1/Q2 yes) pause the instrument, run the C-SSRS screener, pin a resources strip, raise an urgent flag and switch the counselor to a safety-focused prompt.

nodes.label: ADR-005 Consent-based patient to psychologist linking
nodes.norm_label: adr-005 consent-based patient to psychologist linking
nodes.rationale: Spec said clinicians see anonymised data; proposal said clinicians forward and prioritise patients, which needs identity. Resolution: patient links by invite code and chooses scopes including identity; unlinked data stays pseudonymous.

nodes.label: ADR-006 Vision runs in the browser by default
nodes.norm_label: adr-006 vision runs in the browser by default
nodes.rationale: Uploading webcam video of distressed people is a large privacy and cost burden. MediaPipe computes metrics locally and only numbers upload: privacy by default, no GPU in the live product, while consented research recordings keep a server pipeline for the model comparison.

nodes.label: ADR-007 Behavioural markers never flag alone
nodes.norm_label: adr-007 behavioural markers never flag alone
nodes.rationale: Webcam and voice markers vary with lighting, hardware, culture and neurodiversity; their link to clinical states is what the study tests, not an established fact. Markers appear only as context beside instrument scores with quality indicators: less demo wow, far more defensible to clinicians and the ethics committee.

nodes.label: ADR-009 English UI, Roman Urdu understood
nodes.norm_label: adr-009 english ui, roman urdu understood
nodes.rationale: English interface and instruments; counselor, crisis lexicon and filler detection handle Roman Urdu. Urdu-script UI with validated Urdu instruments comes after the FYP.

nodes.label: ADR-012 Two crisis responses, not one
nodes.norm_label: adr-012 two crisis responses, not one
nodes.rationale: Spec described a single Hard Stop. Treating every PHQ-9 item 9 answer above zero as an emergency locks out people who need a gentler follow-up and teaches under-reporting, so a safety pathway handles moderate signals and Hard Stop handles high signals. Status: accepted, pending clinician review.

nodes.label: Behavioural Medical Imaging
nodes.rationale: Treat webcam and voice signals as measurable regions of interest, the way a radiologist reads a scan.

nodes.label: Guided Volition
nodes.rationale: Screening style where the system leads with one structured question and finite answer buttons and the person chooses; replaces the empty chat box.

nodes.label: Principle: scores never come from an LLM
nodes.norm_label: principle: scores never come from an llm
nodes.rationale: Instrument scores are deterministic rule-based computations; LLMs only rephrase and converse.

nodes.label: Item rephrasing rules
nodes.rationale: Model returns one sentence that must keep timeframe, frequency sense and symptom and may not add answer-suggesting examples, preserving instrument validity.

nodes.label: Counselor behaviour rules
nodes.rationale: Never name a disorder, discuss medication, predict outcomes, engage delusion content, claim to be human, or pathologise religious or cultural expressions of distress; use gender-neutral language.

nodes.label: Empathetic neutrality
nodes.rationale: Response style for delusions or hallucinations: neither argue with, confirm nor explore the content; acknowledge fear and point to a professional.

nodes.label: Higher response wins (accept false positives)
nodes.rationale: When detectors disagree the higher response wins; a missed crisis costs far more than an interrupted chat.

nodes.label: App Shell Layout
nodes.rationale: Desktop only, min 1024 px; 240 px collapsible sidebar, 56 px top bar with role label and 'Get help now' (patient only); role-specific content grids on a 4 px spacing grid.

nodes.label: Content Design Rules
nodes.rationale: Sentence case; buttons say the action (never 'Submit'/'OK'); 'Score 12 of 27'; 24-hour times for clinicians, 12-hour for patients.

nodes.label: CrisisScreen component
nodes.rationale: Full viewport, paper background, neel tel: buttons 56 px; no saffron and no severity colours.

nodes.label: DeltaChip component

nodes.label: EmptyState component

nodes.label: ADR-001 Modular monolith with a worker
nodes.norm_label: adr-001 modular monolith with a worker
nodes.rationale: Three students, 25 weeks, one deploy target. One FastAPI service with strict module boundaries, one arq worker, one Postgres, one Redis: simple ops, heavy AI jobs never block requests, modules talk through service interfaces so a module can be split out later.

nodes.label: ADR-002 Start clean, drop the Customer Insight Portal scaffold
nodes.norm_label: adr-002 start clean, drop the customer insight portal scaffold
nodes.rationale: The folder held a scaffold and PRD for an unrelated customer-feedback analytics product; the vault replaces it and source documents moved to source-docs/.

nodes.label: ADR-003 Hosted LLM API first, fine-tuned model later
nodes.norm_label: adr-003 hosted llm api first, fine-tuned model later
nodes.rationale: Fine-tuning Gemma 3 / Qwen 3 before the product exists blocks every other feature. A provider interface from day one lets Claude run via API during build, fine-tune in Phase 9, and the better model per task win by config. Trade-off: early per-call cost and a PII scrub before API calls; thesis keeps its fine-tuning contribution.

nodes.label: ADR-004 pgvector in Postgres, schema-level separation
nodes.norm_label: adr-004 pgvector in postgres, schema-level separation
nodes.rationale: Patient and scholar data must never mix. One Postgres with pgvector, five schemas, per-module DB login roles and RLS on patient tables enforce separation in the database, not by convention, and remove a service (ChromaDB/Qdrant).

nodes.label: ADR-008 Desktop web only for the FYP
nodes.norm_label: adr-008 desktop web only for the fyp
nodes.rationale: Minimum width 1024 px; mobile and PWA deferred until after the FYP.

nodes.label: ADR-010 Marketplace deferred
nodes.rationale: Defence deck mentions booking, digital wallets, escrow and telehealth rooms; out of FYP scope and listed under Post-FYP in Phases.

nodes.label: ADR-011 Name is ZehenSync AI
nodes.rationale: NeuroLens in older documents refers to the same project; that name is retired.

nodes.label: Wordmark (outlined Newsreader Medium, 72 pt optical size)

nodes.rationale: Outlined to vector paths with native kerning and -0.018 em tracking so files need no installed font and render identically everywhere. In the lockup the mark is 1.2x cap height with a 0.26 em gap.

nodes.label: Zaal mark (Kufic ذ with saffron nuqta)
nodes.norm_label: zaal mark (kufic ذ with saffron nuqta)
nodes.rationale: One broad-nib stroke (stem + base) with a diamond nuqta above. Reads three ways: first letter of zehen, a corner framing a point of focus (behavioural imaging), and nuqta-e-nazar (a point of view).

nodes.label: Rejected logo studies (concepts B-D)
nodes.rationale: Alternatives explored before the Zaal mark. All three keep neel forms around a central saffron diamond, so the colour pair and nuqta survived while the forms (split lens, Latin Z, facing arcs) were dropped.

nodes.label: ZehenSync wordmark (outlined Newsreader)
nodes.rationale: The word 'ZehenSync' set in Newsreader and converted to outline paths, so the lockups render identically without the font installed (inferred).

nodes.label: Pale wordmark tint #EEF0F7
nodes.rationale: Off-white used for the wordmark on dark grounds while the mark itself stays pure white, softening the large type (inferred).

nodes.label: Ink #0E1233 (dark neutral)
nodes.rationale: Near-black navy used for the ink mark and for the wordmark in the light-ground lockups.

nodes.label: Saffron #E3A33B (nuqta accent)
nodes.rationale: Kept constant across neel, ink, reversed and app-icon colourways; dropped only in the single-colour mono mark.

nodes.label: Zaal mark (Kufic Urdu letter ذ)
nodes.rationale: Angular Kufic rendering of ذ (Zaal): an upright stem joined to a flat base, with the letter's single dot as a saffron diamond. ذ is the initial of ذہن (zehen, 'mind'), so the glyph spells the first letter of the product name (inferred). Chosen over the rejected studies B-D.

nodes.label: Rejected study B: Split Lens
nodes.rationale: Two offset neel half-discs (upper and lower) around a saffron diamond keyed out with a white stroke; reads as two lenses or halves merging. Rejected.

nodes.label: Rejected study C: Z-Trace
nodes.rationale: Latin Z made of two neel bars and a diagonal, with a saffron diamond at the centre. Rejected, apparently in favour of the Urdu letter as the Z-sound initial.

nodes.label: Rejected study D: Two Minds
nodes.rationale: Two facing heavy neel arcs (two minds) bracketing a saffron diamond, a literal take on syncing minds. Rejected.

nodes.label: Logo usage rules (clear space, minimum size, don'ts)
nodes.norm_label: logo usage rules (clear space, minimum size, don'ts)
nodes.rationale: Half a nuqta clear space around the mark, one nuqta around lockups; mark min 16 px, lockup min 96 px. Nuqta stays saffron in every colour version; moving it (e.g. below the letter) makes a different letter. No rotate/outline/stretch/gradients/glow; never inside a brain, head or speech bubble.

nodes.label: Mark construction (45° symmetry, 24° nib cuts, 11-unit stroke)
nodes.norm_label: mark construction (45° symmetry, 24° nib cuts, 11-unit stroke)
nodes.rationale: Mark mirrors across the y=x diagonal in a 64-unit drawing; stem and base are one reflected stroke; terminals cut at 24° as if drawn by one broad pen; stem is four strokes tall, measured like a letter in nuqtas; nuqta is a 13-unit 45° diamond centred at (26,26).

nodes.label: Nuqta diamond motif
nodes.rationale: The dot (nuqta) of ذ drawn as a 45-degree square in saffron. It is the one element common to the final mark, all three rejected studies and six of the thirteen UI icons, so it works as the brand's portable signature.
